verdict: Dr. Muhammad Ayaz looks like he personally engineered linear algebra just to ensure 40% of the class fails their midterms.
detailedQuote: The brown button-down and wrinkled beige trousers combination screams 'I haven't updated my lecture slides since 2011 and I refuse to round a 79.9% to an 80% out of pure spite.' Standing with his hands tucked behind his back while torturing students with subspace closures is a level of academic menace that not even a pair of orthopaedic sneakers can soften.

inventory.name: Brown Long-Sleeve Button-Up Shirt of Pure Despair
inventory.description: A dismal, sludge-brown button-down shirt that looks like it was harvested directly from an unventilated department lounge in 1998.

inventory.name: Khaki Beige Chinos of Tenured Apathy
inventory.description: Wrinkled beige trousers that have long given up on crisp tailoring, sagging with the emotional weight of 500 ungraded linear algebra finals.

inventory.name: Dark Navy Orthopedic Commuter Kicks
inventory.description: Depressingly sensible dark low-top sneakers designed specifically for pacing back and forth in front of a smartboard while ignoring frantic raised hands.
